transcriptionMethod: Factual numerical transcription from primary publisher HTML tables read 2026-10-17. Publisher pages were readable through web search; local HTML requests returned 403. This file is not a raw publisher archive.

hplc.name: Patel et al. (2013) · paracetamol calibration Table 1
hplc.protocol: Patel MG, Shah RR, Shah KH, Malik BM; PharmaTutor, 24 February 2013, Table 1, paracetamol, n=5. Licrosphere C18 250 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm; methanol:THF 90:10, pH 8.2 with 0.1% triethylamine; 254 nm; 1 mL/min. Unweighted regression of published mean peak areas.

sources.title: Development and validation of RP-HPLC method for Tolperisone hydrochloride and Paracetamol in Pharmaceutical Formulation · Table 1
sources.license: Publisher terms apply; numerical facts transcribed, no article text reproduced

hplc.limitations: Five concentration-level means, not individual injections. No chromatogram is reconstructed. Published SD remains experimental SD; fitted coefficients are recomputed from rounded means.

qc.name: Patel et al. (2013) · paracetamol recovery Table 5
qc.protocol: Same Patel et al. RP-HPLC method as the calibration preset. Table 5 paracetamol standard addition, n=3; original 500 mg plus 0, 250, 500, 750 mg added. Fit measured total found against nominal total, not percentage recovery against amount added.

sources.title: Patel et al. · Table 5 accuracy / recovery
sources.license: Publisher terms apply; numerical facts transcribed

qc.limitations: Four rounded recovery means; empirical response fit, not batch release certification or an independent validation of this model. No raw peak areas inferred.

adme.protocol: Rapid quantification of acetaminophen in plasma using solid-phase microextraction coupled with thermal desorption electrospray ionization mass spectrometry, Table 1, LC/MS/MS column. Single healthy volunteer from a 31-volunteer study; fasted oral Ultracet containing 325 mg acetaminophen; each sample tested once. Source rows 10 and 11 list 4 h before 3 h; times retained as printed, sorted only for display.

sources.title: Shiea et al. · primary Table 1 (LC/MS/MS)
sources.license: Publisher terms apply; numerical facts transcribed

adme.limitations: One participant, no reported replicate SD. Fit S(exp(−ke t)−exp(−ka t)); S is a fitted concentration scale, not an identified volume or bioavailability. No dose scaling or clinical dosing advice. Internal leave-one-time-point-out assessment is not participant-level validation.
